column1: # Which of the original's pictures belong to one screen alone.
# `extract-art` writes a picture listed here to `assets-local/screens/<screen>/` and not to
# `assets-local/art/<lbx>/`; every other picture stays in `art/` (shared pictures, figures,
# terrain, map sprites, spell effects). Only numbers and names: no art in this file.
# Columns: lbx (lower-case file name), first entry, last entry, screen (folder name), label.
# A label names a single entry's file (`<label>_<frame>.png`); without one the file is
# `<lbx>_<entry>_<frame>.png`. Ranges may name entries the file does not have; the entry
# numbers are the original's own (`LBX_Load(main_lbx_file, 8)` is `main 8`). Where the
# original loads a picture is in ReMoM's LOADER.c and the screen's own file (named below).
# A picture that several screens use lives with its main screen; the others find it through
# Load / Save (LoadScr.c) and Settings (Settings.c); entry 4 (OK) is also Settings'
# End of game (CONQUEST.c); Spell of Mastery (SPLMASTR.c)
# Overland screen (LOADER.c, MainScr.c); the spell cast, road and surveyor screens have their own
# City screen (CityScr.c, LOADER.c): backgrnd 24 (red button), 42 and 73 (gold) are used elsewhere.
# The city picture (`cityscap`: backdrop, houses, trees, buildings) is also the outpost and enemy
# The citizens of each race (`backgrnd` 45 farmers, 59 workers and 74 rebels, plus the race's number),
# filed by race so each race's three pictures are one sprite pack.
# Magic screen (MagicScr.c) and its alchemy window; entries 6 and 51 (grey gems) are also
# the Spell of Mastery's and a spell animation's
# Diplomacy (DIPLOMAC.c); diplomac 1 and backgrnd 18 (the mirror) are also used by spell animations
# Unit statistics (UnitStat.c) and the enemy stack list (UnitList.c)
# Combat (Combat.c, LOADER.c Reload_Combat_Graphics_Cache); the battlefield ground (cmbgrass and the
# like) is filed as battle tiles by `Placer` (screens.rs), not here
# Army list (ArmyList.c) and Item screen (ItemScrn.c); entries 1 and 2 (the arrows) are the City
# list's (CityList.c, which also loads reload 21 and 22) and the Army list's also
# Item crafting (ItemMake.c): the kind buttons (14 to 23, then the chosen state 25 to 34), the
# picture arrows, the OK button and the spell charges
# Undead rising after a battle (`Undead_Animation_Load`, SPLMASTR.c; undead_scene.rs): the
# graveyard, the mist and the two layers of earth. The figure is a MONSTER.LBX picture (art/summoning/).
# The wizard's lab (`wizlab.lbx`; Learn_Spell_Animation, the Spell of Mastery lost scene): the room,
# the podium, the blue column (ten frames) and the five realm familiars (14 + the strongest realm:
# nature, sorcery, chaos, life, death); 22 and 23 are two frost pictures the client does not draw.
# The wizards' own lab pictures (entries 0 to 13) are filed with each wizard (`wizard_art.ron`).
# The Info button's list box, "Select An Advisor" (`Selection_Box` in GENDRAW.c, also the Tax Collector's
# rates): the marble frame, the five row buttons and their right ends, the scroll pieces of a box
# with more rows than fit (the client draws none of them; entry 11 is that scroll bar's segment).
# The summoning scene (`Summon_Animation`, summon_scene.rs): the frame, the flame behind and the one in
# front of the summoned creature (each also in the six realm colours, `_summon_N`), the six palettes
# (61 grey, 62 to 66 the realms). The creature's own picture is `monster.lbx`, filed as
# `summon_figure_NNN` by `Placer::place_used`; the caster is the wizard's `summon` picture.
